title: docs(releases/v19): the breaking-changes list has no bullet for the retired staged-edit model of the data grid (#35827, PR #37437)
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Filing gate: ① shipped text out of step with what shipped (release page). Source: fleet. Out-of-scope finding of zone o3-package on PR #37916 (#37522), which closes with that PR, so the seat files it.
Grading: area:ux · Documentation · p2 · domain:docs.
Reader: seat repo:objectstack#3, zone o3-ux (area:ux p2).
Dedupe: `releases/v19` open: only #37522 (step-19 count, being closed by PR #37916). `37437 staged`: #37521 (a README and comment, other files), #35827 (closed, the change itself). None covers the release page's breaking list.

Business reason: an app team upgrading to 19 reads the v19 release page to learn what will break. The data grid's staged edit model (`cellSelection={false}`, pending changes held until the grid's Save) is retired in 19.0.0-next.0 (#35827, PR #37437), so a grid that relied on it now behaves differently. Without a line on the page, the team finds out from users.

## What
- The v19 release page's breaking-changes list has no bullet for #37437. Measured by zone o3-package against main: the page has 0 hits for `staged` and 0 for `37437`. The page's step-19 migration entry count already names `data-table-staged-edit-retired` (PR #37916).
- Add one bullet in the page's own form: what was retired, what a grid does now, and what an author changes. Link #35827 and the migration entry.

## Acceptance
- The breaking list carries the bullet, and the docs gates pass.
